bullets.title: Closed near lows

bullets.title: Day's range
bullets.text: Monday's range was 3,832.20 to 3,902.30, so the 3,832 low from earlier reports is now confirmed (Kitco).

bullets.title: Fed hike priced
bullets.text: Markets price about 92% odds of a December quarter-point hike and 8% of a half-point (CME via Trading Economics).

bullets.title: Yields and dollar
bullets.text: The US 10-year is near 5.13% and the dollar index near 103.6, close to a 19-20 month high (Trading Economics).

bullets.title: Fed speakers hawkish
bullets.text: Schmid and Daly said inflation is still too high; what Hammack said tonight is UNVERIFIED because no report was found.

bullets.title: Risk-off, oil lower
bullets.text: US stocks fell about 1.8% on a tech selloff and crude fell about 3.7%, which did not help gold (Trading Economics).

bullets.title: Tuesday data
bullets.text: Retail sales are forecast at +0.2% after +0.8%; a strong number can push yields up and gold down (Bullion Trading Center).
